source_checks: The original figure visibly has a logarithmic rate axis despite linearly incrementing labels2..8 times10^-11; unequal tick distances and the seven-point log fit agree. Red crosses identify the TRPMD series, and the primary article identifies zero friction with RPMD. Black quantum curves and the green fit are not substituted for red markers.

The200K zero-friction cross lies below the lowest labeled2e-11 major tick, within the displayed axis extent. Its extracted value uses a modest log-axis extrapolation, also checked with the two nearest major ticks; this is explicit rather than described as bracketed interpolation.

The visible temperature order is200,300,500K from bottom to top. TableII gives384,256,64 beads,2 product channels,Rinf30bohr,xi_dagger.9671/.9885/.9947,childdt.0001ps and duration.2ps,500000 children. These match the source-protocol record.
The primary text names Stark-Werner for F+H2 and cites Stark/Werner JCP104,6515(1996). That identifies a potential family, not the exact executable/source/parameter variant.
D+MuH is a different reactant arrangement from Mu+H2. Its source index must remain labeled as published.
The TeX uses a dynamic date macro. A modern rendered arXiv HTML date is not the original publication date; the journal source identifies2015.
